professional_domain.name: Phase-level architecture design owner
responsibilities: Turn a confirmed product baseline into an architectural model of forces, boundaries, options, decisions, contracts, migration, verification, rollback, and downstream handoff.
Use product facts, code facts, runtime facts, and user-confirmed quality priorities to decide what must be designed and what must be routed back upstream.
Own the final design artifact before review: self-check the design, expose tradeoffs, and submit a coherent design.json for advisory review.
Close reviewer findings into either design changes or explicit downstream constraints, then prove the canonical design artifact is consumable by test-design and tech-lead.
non_goals: Define product scope or acceptance criteria that product-director/product-manager did not confirm.
Write detailed test cases, implementation tasks, QA verdicts, or production rollout execution plans.
Treat schema fields, candidate packages, projections, or reviewer mechanics as the professional flow itself.
Generate human-readable projections unless the canonical design.json has already passed validation and the user or process needs the view.
professional_domain.success_boundary: The Skill is successful when design.json represents an architect-owned, evidence-backed, reviewed, validated, and downstream-consumable design; optional projections are derived after that, not part of the core design completion.

practice_flow_confirmed: Intake and baseline gate: confirm the product baseline is eligible for design or route upstream.
Stakeholders and concerns: identify who consumes the architecture and what each role needs answered.
Architecture-significant requirements: separate requirements that affect structure, quality attributes, boundaries, runtime behavior, or evolution from ordinary product detail.
Current-state evidence: collect code, interface, data, deployment, and runtime facts that constrain design.
Complexity modeling: model business rules, state, consistency, boundaries, failures, operations, and likely evolution.
Decision identification: identify both upstream-hinted decisions and new architecture decisions emerging from UNIT, code, or runtime facts.
Option tradeoff: compare materially different options with costs, risks, failure modes, and verification paths; get explicit user confirmation for meaningful tradeoffs.
Design synthesis: form module, data, interface, runtime, cross-cutting, migration, rollback, verification, impact, risk, and handoff contracts.
Owner self-check: the design owner proves the artifact is coherent, complete enough, consumable, and validator-ready before review.
Advisory review: architecture/product/test reviewers review the self-checked design artifact and return advisory findings; they do not own the design.
Finalization: the design owner fixes or explicitly carries findings, records final user confirmation, and freezes canonical design.json.
Optional projection: after validated design.json, derive human-readable design projection or ADR only when needed.
current_state.discarded_premature_strategy_note: The earlier strategy_candidate was produced before the user explicitly confirmed scene/responsibility depth. It is retained only as a draft signal and must not be treated as frozen strategy.

`/tech-lead` consumes design.json boundaries, key decisions, scope, dependencies, and verification evidence to plan tasks.
`delivery-owner` and runtime readiness tooling consume design.json through artifact registry and phase readiness checks.
`shared/hooks/registry.json` invokes design/scripts/completion_check.sh as the completion gate for docs/*/phase-*/design.json.
`shared/runtime/standard-chain-catalog.json` registers design.json schema/template/default path as the design artifact contract.
tests/evals consume design SKILL.md, reviewer prompts, scripts, examples, and fixture design.json files.
questionable_or_internal_consumers: `candidate_design_json` and `$TMPDIR/design-candidate-package.json` are internal review mechanics, but evals/tests currently treat them as central S9 truth.
`render_projection.py` is a real optional post-processor, but current S10 text mixes it into finalization.
Hidden field-test feedback files under shared/skills/design are useful refinement evidence but have no default runtime consumer.
reference_summary: Most references have identifiable step consumers and are short: decision templates, quality attributes, runtime fact capture, interface spec, risk assessment, architecture/service/legacy choices, reviewer prompts, and canonical ref cheatsheet.
The issue is not raw reference count; it is that SKILL.md repeats field/schema mechanics instead of routing to references/scripts at the moment of use.

problem_cards.phenomenon: The main flow reads like staged construction of fields and candidate packages rather than architecture work.
problem_cards.why_problem: A design Skill should guide architectural reasoning and ownership; field-first flow makes the agent optimize for schema satisfaction before deciding the architecture.
problem_cards.target_shape: Architectural practice flow leads; schema/scripts become validation and carrier details.
problem_cards.verification: Run skill body quality/static tests and a design dogfood flow; inspect that S3-S10 stage names describe professional actions, not field mechanics.
problem_cards.stop_condition: If downstream validators require candidate package as the only anti-drift mechanism and cannot be replaced safely, stop and redesign the digest mechanism first.

problem_cards.phenomenon: S9 review is locked to `$TMPDIR/design-candidate-package.json` and candidate_design_json by evals and tests.
problem_cards.why_problem: The user expects real-team review of the architect's output; reviewing only draft/candidate state weakens design owner accountability and creates S10 recomposition complexity.
problem_cards.target_shape: Reviewer input is a self-checked design artifact or its controlled digest, and finalization records review closure without reinterpreting a draft.
problem_cards.verification: Tests must prove reviewers no longer receive candidate_design_json as their required truth source and still preserve anti-drift/digest guarantees.
problem_cards.stop_condition: If review_digest.py cannot support review of design.json without breaking canonical validation, pause for a script contract decision.

problem_cards.phenomenon: References feel excessive because the main SKILL.md exposes their field-writing detail instead of using them as on-demand professional aids.
problem_cards.why_problem: Context cost and cognitive load move into the hot path; useful references become indistinguishable from noise.
problem_cards.target_shape: Keep references with consumers, remove or relocate unconsumed evidence files, and make SKILL.md route to references only at decision points.
problem_cards.verification: Every retained reference has Trigger/Read/Consume-like usage from a flow step, script, eval, or test; unconsumed hidden field-test files are moved to refinement evidence or archive.
problem_cards.stop_condition: Do not delete references merely because they are numerous; deletion requires proof of no consumer or replaced consumer.

problem_cards.phenomenon: S10 mixes final confirmation, final write, validation, digest recovery, projection rendering, ADR generation, and projection QA.
problem_cards.why_problem: The completion boundary becomes unreadable and optional views look like part of design correctness.
problem_cards.target_shape: S10 finalizes and validates design.json only; S11/post-step derives optional projection or ADR after validation.
problem_cards.verification: Completion checklist treats projection as optional post-processing and design completion remains valid without projection generation.
problem_cards.stop_condition: If a downstream consumer requires projection before test-design/tech-lead, document that consumer first instead of hiding it inside S10.

strategy_candidate.operation_note: Rewrite within the existing design Skill carrier, not create/split/replace the Skill. This is a flow and contract rewrite, not a new skill.
scope: Reshape SKILL.md around architect practice rather than field construction.
Prefer positive, goal-oriented instructions that tell the agent what good execution looks like.
Make stakeholders/concerns and architecture-significant requirements explicit before decision exploration.
Clarify that product-provided design decision candidates are hints, while design may discover new technical decisions from UNIT/code/runtime facts.
Change S9 review object from candidate package to owner self-checked canonical-shaped design artifact.
Split optional projection/ADR into an independent post-validation step.
Audit references for consumers; retain short professional references by default, move historical field-test notes out of active default path if unconsumed.
Update or delete reviewer prompts, evals, and tests that currently lock candidate_design_json as the review truth; do not preserve wrong historical behavior for compatibility.
Preserve deterministic validators, completion gate, canonical schema, reference integrity check, and downstream design.json contract.
exclusions: No product-director/product-manager schema redesign in this round unless required by tests.
No broad design.schema.json breaking change unless the review-object shift proves impossible without it.
No deletion of currently consumed references without updating or replacing the consumer.
No runtime-installed copy edit until source strategy is confirmed and source changes pass.
strategy_candidate.risk: The biggest risk is breaking the existing anti-drift digest and tests that intentionally forbid reviewer prompt references to final design.json; this must be handled as an eval/test contract migration, not as blind text edits.
success_standards: SKILL.md main flow reads as architecture practice, not schema field construction.
Most stage instructions are framed as positive target behavior; negative wording remains only for safety red lines, anti-bypass constraints, and boundary clarification.
Reviewer prompts and tests review the owner self-checked design artifact rather than candidate_design_json as the required truth source.
Canonical design.json remains the sole default downstream control artifact.
Projection/ADR generation is optional post-validation work and no longer part of core completion.
References retained in active path have explicit step/script/eval/test consumers.
Historical reports, tests, or eval anchors that encode wrong behavior are updated, moved, or deleted instead of compatibility-preserved.
Structural and empirical verification pass on design scripts and fixtures.
ambiguities_to_resolve_before_edit: Exact review artifact shape: recommended canonical-shaped design payload without final_confirmation/review_closure, not a candidate package wrapper.
Digest contract: preserve anti-drift by hashing the reviewed design payload; do not make candidate package the professional review object.
Historical evidence files: decide whether to move .field-test-* into refinement evidence/archive or keep only if a current test/eval consumes them.
Positive guidance boundary: convert noisy negative prose to target behavior, but keep hard stop rules where bypass would corrupt downstream artifacts.
verification_plan: Static/body quality checks for skill package and no-noise constraints.
Design governance tests that cover SKILL.md, reviewer prompts, manifest, hooks, and projection boundaries.
Dogfood/e2e design tests on existing real fixtures.
Fresh empirical script runs because design has scripts and depends on project structure.
